top_signals.title: Yen Holds Most of Its Gains After Thursday's 2% Rise
top_signals.summary: The yen held most of its gains Friday after advancing more than 2% on Thursday. A rush to unwind yen-funded carry trades helped send the currency to a one-month high against the dollar as traders ramped up bets on further Bank of Japan rate hikes. Bloomberg's David Savage reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin reclaims $80K as DXY falls amid continuing suspected yen intervention
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin rallied 5% to reclaim $80,000 as the US dollar weakened amid a suspected Bank of Japan currency intervention, though analysts remain split on the impact.

top_signals.title: ADNOC Keeps Loading LNG as Hormuz Risks Intensify
top_signals.summary: Emirati ADNOC is still loading liquefied natural gas in the Persian Gulf despite the latest exchange of strikes between the United States and Iran, Bloomberg has reported, citing satellite imaging data. The data showed one tanker docked at ADNOC’s Das Island export terminal on September 2, with another one in the vicinity of the terminal as well.
